# Zebra Technologies Upgrades RFID Readers with Impinj Gen2X for Improved Item-Level Visibility and Traceability


##


Zebra adds Gen2X® support to its RFID handhelds, sleds, and fixed readers, improving RFID performance and enabling new capabilities for digitizing and automating enterprise workflows


When Impinj introduced[Gen2X](https://www.impinj.com/products/technology/gen2x) – a standards-compatible enhancement to the RAIN RFID protocol that improves the performance of RFID solutions in real-world enterprise deployments – we made it widely available to the RAIN industry, enabling manufacturers to add support to both new and already popular readers. Today, we’re excited to announce that intelligent operations leader Zebra is upgrading its[portfolio of RFID](https://www.zebra.com/us/en/products/rfid.html) handhelds, sleds, and fixed readers with support for Impinj Gen2X.


Zebra is adding Gen2X support to improve handheld and overhead reading of hard-to-read items, boost the accuracy and speed of autonomous track-and-trace solutions in challenging conditions, and use RFID tags to help inhibit fraudulent items and returns. At this week’s annual RAIN in Action Summit, Impinj and Zebra are demonstrating Gen2X performance on Zebra handheld devices, illustrating how tags and readers with Gen2X support can improve reading performance in challenging real-world settings.


RFID tagging is now expanding into categories such as grocery, jewelry, health and beauty, and pharmaceuticals – product types that were historically difficult to tag and inventory, yet are important to achieving item-level visibility across enterprise operations. As a leading RAIN RFID pioneer and innovator, Impinj developed Gen2X to address these real-world challenges and improve autonomous fixed reading solutions at enterprise scale, enabling reliable item visibility across small retail merchandise, densely packed items, and products containing liquids and metals.


These innovations now support use cases ranging from supply chain traceability and overhead inventory visibility to self-checkout and loss prevention. Extending RFID tagging to more items and use cases empowers enterprises to automate workflows using Physical Intelligence: the reliable real-world visibility enterprise AI systems need to see everything, waste nothing, and act instantly.


“As RAIN RFID adoption continues to scale across global enterprises, Zebra is focused on delivering innovations that improve real-world performance and usability,” said Chip Yager, Vice President and General Manager, Advanced Locationing Technology, Zebra Technologies. “By enabling Gen2X across our handhelds, sleds, and fixed readers, we’re helping customers achieve more reliable reads, faster inventory, and greater accuracy, especially in challenging environments.”


“Zebra was our first licensee for Gen2X, and we are excited to see this innovation expand across a wide range of Zebra handheld, sled, and fixed readers,” said Gahan Richardson, executive vice president and general manager, Impinj. “Extending Gen2X across its portfolio, Zebra is helping enterprises obtain item-level visibility into a wider range of use cases, accelerating the adoption of RAIN RFID at scale.”


Zebra devices with Gen2X support are available now, including handhelds (MC33 family, TC22R, TC501, TC701), sleds (RFD40 family, RFD90 family), and fixed/overhead readers (FXR90, FX9600, FX7500, ATR7000). Gen2X capabilities will be available across Zebra’s RFID portfolio via seamless firmware upgrades. Learn more about Gen2X[here](https://www.impinj.com/products/technology/gen2x) . Impinj is a technology partner in Zebra’s award-winning[PartnerConnect](https://www.zebra.com/us/en/partners/partnerconnect.html) Program.
